text: Onside. No touch. Enzo was sleeping. Goal.
direction: Middle-aged British man, dry clipped bureaucratic diction, thin precise voice. An officious British official issuing a ludicrously overconfident verdict. ONSIDE. NO TOUCH. Then dismiss the objection with smug certainty: ENZO was SLEEPING. A short deliberate pause, then an emphatic final GOAL. Dry comic finality, crisp authoritative diction, no soft fading endings.
